description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers.
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Orzhov Basilica's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
